IS 15782 : 2008 Textiles - Method for Determinig Deterioration of Visibility Due to Smoke Released on Combustion of MaterialsICS 13.220.40;59.080.30TXD 32Reaffirmed 20181 ScopeThis standard specifies a method to determine thedeterioration of visibility due to smoke produced whenmaterials burn in a given sealed chamber, by assessingthe attenuation of a light beam passing through thechamber. The method is applicable to combustion ofall kinds of materials including textiles.

1 ScopeThis standard specifies a method to determine thedeterioration of visibility due to smoke produced whenmaterials burn in a given sealed chamber, by assessingthe attenuation of a light beam passing through thechamber. The method is applicable to combustion ofall kinds of materials including textiles.
